notes: PAP reference G31/0212. Direct private-owner sale of a bright four-room apartment in central Auxerre, close to the cathedral. The full advert describes an entrance into a fully fitted kitchen, two bedrooms, a combined living and dining room, an office, bathroom and separate WC. The apartment is on the first floor of a small condominium with intercom and is stated to be in very good condition with good-quality equipment. The detail page exposed twelve property photos; the retained URL is the first source photo. Charges, taxe fonciere and energy grade are not exposed in accessible page text.

PAP reference G43/0153. Direct private-owner sale of a two-room apartment 500 metres from the IUT in Auxerre. The full advert describes a second-floor dwelling with lift, entrance, living room, bedroom, kitchen and shower room with WC. A space in a closed car park and a cellar are included; the double-glazed windows and electric roller shutters are new. Charges of about EUR 2,800 in 2024 include heating. DPE E and GES E are explicitly stated, with assessment dated 3 June 2025. The detail page exposed twelve property photos; the retained URL is the first source photo. Taxe fonciere is not exposed.

Century 21 Martinot Immobilier reference 20408. The active detail page shows six property photos plus a virtual tour and a full description of a first-floor F3 in central Auxerre. The 61.93 m2 apartment has parquet, mouldings and an old fireplace, a bedroom with direct bathroom/WC access, two living rooms, kitchen, storage and a private 6 m2 exterior. The current layout can support a second bedroom and the kitchen wall is described as non-load-bearing. No works are stated as necessary. DPE D and GES D are exposed, with DPE dated 8 July 2026. Annual current charges are EUR 150 in a six-lot volunteer-managed condominium with no proceeding. Taxe fonciere and publication date are not exposed.

Century 21 Martinot Immobilier reference 20334. The active detail page shows six property photos and a full description of a second-floor F1 in a quiet Auxerre building.
